## Title
类型：简洁、准确地概括PR的核心更改 [ e.g. feat:添加xxx模块 ]
> 类型参考：**Change Type**

## Linked Issue/PR
- Closed #
- Fixed #
- Resolved #
- Related #

## Summary
Describe the problem and fix in 2–5 bullets:

- Problem:
- Why it matters:
- What changed:
- What did NOT change (scope boundary):

## Change Type (select at least one of them)

- [ ] 错误修复 (Bug fix)
- [ ] 功能添加 (Feature)
- [ ] 代码重构 (Refactor)
- [ ] 性能优化 (Performance)
- [ ] 测试添加/修改 (Tests)
- [ ] 文档改进 (Docs)
- [ ] 依赖更新 (Dependencies)
- [ ] 样式/格式化 (Style)
- [ ] 基础维护/辅助工具 (Chore)
- [ ] 其他 (Others)

## Evidence
Attach at least one:

- [ ] Failing test/log before + passing after
- [ ] Trace/log snippets
- [ ] Screenshot/recording
- [ ] Perf numbers (if relevant)
- [ ] Others(e.g. Commit ID):
